New York: One of seven men indicted in the $100 million Brink's jewelry heist has agreed to plead guilty.

Carlos Victor Mestanza Cercado signed a plea deal cutting six robbery and theft counts to one, National Jeweler reports, citing court filings in California. Two alleged co-conspirators are still at large; three other alleged co-conspirators face trial in March 2027.
